pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with variable edge sharpness. Some regions exhibit smooth pixel gradients at boundaries while others show higher contrast. Patch size is heterogeneous, increasing in area from the hindquarters toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light-toned pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of corridors is non-uniform, narrowing at points of close patch proximity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the cervical and thoracic dorsal line, corresponding to short, dense hair clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertically-oriented, dark linear anomaly is present on the mid-flank. The mark exhibits high contrast against the lighter background pelage and appears as a localized textural and pigmentary disruption.
